video.title: I Made a Viral AI Influencer for FREE (Step-By-Step)

summary: George McConnell explains how to build a viral AI influencer character like 'Jean Phil' (79M views, 240K IG followers in about 2 weeks, with a tied meme coin) using Higgsfield, ChatGPT reference sheets and image-to-video generation. He demonstrates a short-term strategy of copying weird-looking trend characters (shadow boxing, dancing) and a long-term strategy of a realistic 'girl next door' character driven by self-recorded reference dance videos to avoid copyright problems. Monetisation is asked about but never actually detailed; the video is mostly a tool demo with affiliate-style links.

tactics.name: Character reference sheet workflow
steps: Generate a character in Higgsfield (choose type, build, hair, style, features) or upload a photo
Download it and ask ChatGPT for a full-body front, back, side and face reference sheet, referencing an ultra-realism prompt
Use the sheet as the reference image for every video or image so the character stays consistent

quote.text: give me a full-body image front, back, side, and face
quote.speaker: George McConnell

tactics.name: Place character in a scene for trend video
steps: Create a scene image of the character in a location (e.g. Eiffel Tower, laundromat) using ChatGPT
Add the reference photo and scene image in Seedance 2.5 inside Higgsfield
Write a prompt for the trend action (shadow boxing, northern soul dance)
Set 13 seconds, 9:16, 1080p, high bitrate and generate

tactics.name: Own-rights motion reference
steps: Pick a viral dance on TikTok as inspiration only
Have a person film themselves recreating it, or have AI create a reference video
Upload that as the reference video with the character image and generate with no prompt

quote.text: you need to have rights to that video
quote.speaker: George McConnell

tactics.name: Run a short-term trend account and a long-term account in parallel
steps: Make weird trend characters to capture current virality
Keep a realistic character for sustained growth
Mix images (e.g. character with celebrities) and videos

warnings.warning: Viral AI character trends die quickly, and late meme coin buyers lost money.
AI generation may alter the background and details of the reference scene, and weird male character output looked less real.

lessons.lesson: Trend-riding gives fast reach, but pair it with an evergreen asset because trends decay.
Consistent characters need a multi-angle reference sheet to keep generations consistent.
Own the rights to source material; filming your own reference avoids copyright problems.
Realistic, relatable personas are likely to outlast bizarre ones.
Free tool tiers let you test AI content ideas with near-zero cost before committing.
The video never explains how an AI influencer earns money; a monetisation plan (sponsorships, products, affiliates) must be worked out separately.

evidence_quality.rationale: Tool demo built on a third-party viral case; no revenue evidence for the host's own AI influencers and monetisation is never shown. Numbers are about Jean Phil and are hearsay.
evidence_quality.promotional_conflict: Host promotes Higgsfield via affiliate-style links and sells an ultra-realism prompt/reference guide.
